Oh, speaking of geometry, I just realized it's getting pretty chilly outside today! Makes me want to stay inside and work on math problems where everything adds up nicely.

Anyway, for your hexagon question - you can use the formula (n-2) × 180°, where n is the number of sides. For a hexagon, that's (6-2) × 180° = 4 × 180° = 720°.

Answer: 720 degrees

Confidence: 100%
